discoveries.text: restrict also deletes retro-proposals.json; the plan has retro() copy it to $SCRATCH before restrict only when it differs from the rstart copy (a continued run's old file isn't re-merged), leave it out of the reverted-edits note, and put it back in the run record as retro.md is, so the ledger keeps the evidence

The debrief gatherer needs run ids to flag re-raised items, so it uses `backlog.mjs list --jsonl --max-bytes 6000` (ordered rows); the retro prompt uses the text list (`<id> · <status> · seen <n> · <title>…`), which carries the `test-counts · specced` prefix M1-05 greps
`run 16` is already the parking run's label (tests/checks/13-run-2-michael-sets-desk.sh:261); the plan's checks in 36-run-16-retro-backlog.sh say `backlog run` instead
